name: core-runtime-messaging-inbound-mime-local

evidence.notes: Deterministic local RFC822/MIME body and attachment parsing; this is not Salesforce email-service parity.

source.content:
@isTest private class MessagingInboundMIMEProofTest { @isTest static void parsesMultipartEmail() { String raw = 'From: sender@example.test Subject: multipart Content-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary=outer --outer Content-Type: multipart/alternative; boundary=inner --inner Content-Type: text/plain plain body --inner Content-Type: text/html

html body

--inner-- --outer Content-Type: application/octet-stream Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=data.bin Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64 AQI= --outer-- '; Messaging.InboundEmail inbound = Messaging.extractInboundEmail(Blob.valueOf(raw), false); System.assertEquals('sender@example.test', inbound.fromAddress); System.assertEquals('multipart', inbound.subject); System.assertEquals('plain body', inbound.plainTextBody); System.assertEquals('

html body

', inbound.htmlBody); System.assertEquals(1, inbound.binaryAttachments.size()); System.assertEquals('data.bin', inbound.binaryAttachments[0].fileName); System.assertEquals('application/octet-stream', inbound.binaryAttachments[0].mimeTypeSubType); } }

salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture proves Glade's deterministic local RFC822/MIME model and grants no Salesforce email-service parity credit.
